taskingen.npmScriptGrouping.separator.description: Literal separator used to nest npm script and Deno task names under project folders. An empty value disables grouping.

taskingen.npmScriptGrouping.maxDepth.description: Maximum number of separator-based group levels under each npm or Deno project. Use 0 to disable grouping.

taskingen.npmProjectGrouping.groupByScop.description: Group scoped npm or Deno packages (for example @cemcakirlar/mst-tab-sync) under a shared @scope node.

taskingen.npmProjectGrouping.folderMaxDe.description: How many nearest workspace-relative folder levels to show under npm Scripts, Deno Tasks, and Shell Scripts (counting up from each item). Use 0 for a flat list. Does not limit how deeply package.json, Deno, or shell files are discovered.

taskingen.scriptClickAction.description: What happens when you activate a script name in the tree (see Script Click Mode). Inline Open and Run actions remain available either way.
enumDescriptions: Open the package.json script entry, deno.json task entry, or shell script file in the editor.
Run the script in the terminal.

taskingen.scriptClickMode.description: Whether the configured script action runs on a single click or a double click. Interacts with workbench.list.openMode: when that setting is doubleClick, Taskingen activates when the tree item opens (typically on double click).
enumDescriptions: Activate the script when the tree item opens on a single click (or on double click if workbench.list.openMode is doubleClick).
Activate the script on double click.

taskingen.tree.defaultExpandedDepth.description: How many tree levels are expanded by default. 0 collapses everything, 1 expands only the root npm/Deno/shell groups, and higher values expand deeper project and script groups.

taskingen.favorites.enabled.description: Show the Favorites group at the top of the Taskingen tree with pinned scripts from the current workspace.

taskingen.favorites.maxItems.description: How many pinned scripts to show under Favorites. Newest pins appear first; older pins stay stored and become visible again when a newer pin is removed or this limit is raised.

taskingen.taskHistory.enabled.description: Show the Task History group at the top of the Taskingen tree with recently run scripts from the current workspace folder.

taskingen.taskHistory.maxItems.description: How many recently run scripts to show under Task History.

taskingen.discovery.exclude.description: Gitignore-style patterns for folders and paths to skip when discovering npm, Deno, and shell scripts. Examples: legacy, legacy/**, packages/generated/**, /tools. Lines starting with # are ignored. A leading / limits the pattern to the workspace root.
